summary: Iteration-2 testing: 34/34 new backend tests passed (100%). Covered: hakediş /pay split flow (nakit+çek, auto 'odendi' after both tx approved, site expense not doubled), validations (taslak/missing due_date/zero amounts -> 400), reports export for all 8 tabs (xlsx+pdf), invalid tab 400, filter export, daily-summary (keys + due_items + customer_risks>33%), cron auth (401 no auth, 401 wrong secret, 200 queued with Bearer+X-Webhook-Id, duplicate detection), alerts/history has twilio_yok, alerts/send 400 (no Twilio), site photo upload+list+delete+site progress update, hakediş PDF still 200 after photos, AI work-catalog returns 19 items. Frontend smoke verified: daily-summary-card + toggle + whatsapp btn on dashboard, Reports export triggers both xlsx/pdf downloads (file saved as rapor-{tab}.{ext}), new hakediş page catalog select auto-fills description+unit from 19-item catalog, hakediş detail progress-pay-button opens pay-form, pay-preset-half fills 56400/56400 and reveals check fields, site-photos-card + add-photo-button + photo-form present on site detail. Iteration-1 PDF Content-Disposition bug confirmed FIXED (pdf.py pdf_response uses RFC5987).

ui_bugs.issue: Money component signature is `function Money({ value, className, signed })` and does NOT forward data-testid prop to the rendered <span>. Result: `data-testid="progress-remaining"` set on <Money/> in ProgressDetail.jsx:69 is silently dropped, so automated tests cannot locate the 'Kalan' amount element.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The dev-time instrumentation injects a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> tags of the catalog <select>. Likely harmless in production bundle (no instrumentation) but prints repeated console errors in dev.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning persists from iteration 1 (minor).

action_items: Forward data-testid in Money component: `export function Money({ value, className, signed=false, ...rest }) { return <span {...rest} className=.../>; }` so progress-remaining and similar testids become addressable.
(Optional cosmetic) Suppress or ignore the dev-instrumentation span-in-option hydration warning; may require ignoring in dev plugin config.
(Carried over, not blocking) Add minWidth/minHeight to Dashboard ResponsiveContainer parents to silence Recharts warning.
critical_code_review_comments: progress.py pay_progress: good — status gating (taslak -> 400), explicit nakit+cek validation, cek_amount requires check_due_date, creates one tx per kasa and attaches progress_payment_id via a separate update_one call (not atomic but acceptable for single-user admin workflow).

transactions.py approve(): auto-upgrades parent progress_payment to 'odendi' only when hakedis status is 'onaylandi' and sum(approved tx) >= net_amount - 0.01 — correctly handles rounding and prevents re-set of already paid hakediş. Verified.

site_summary excludes 'Taşeron Hakediş Ödemesi' from direct_expense and uses progress_payments.net_amount for subcontractor_expense — prevents double counting on payment approval. Verified via test_site_expense_not_doubled.
alerts.py cron/daily-reminders: uses hmac.compare_digest for secret, idempotent via X-Webhook-Id (checks alert_logs.run_id), BackgroundTasks for the actual job. Returns 2xx quickly as required.
alerts.send_twilio: imports twilio only inside function (correct — avoids startup dependency). twilio_configured() correctly returns False when env vars missing -> /alerts/send 400.
reports.export_report: tab whitelist via TAB_TITLES, builds subtitle from filters (correctly fetches site/account names), reuses reports() for data — DRY.
sites.add_photo: updates sites.progress_percent only if provided (not None). Good — avoids overwriting progress when just logging a photo.
pdf.pdf_response: RFC5987 header fix verified (ascii fallback + filename*=UTF-8''<encoded>). Iteration-1 bug fully resolved.
Money component (Bits.jsx:34) doesn't accept/forward data-testid — tiny ergonomic bug; a 2-char fix enables testable 'Kalan' amount.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (pytest-xdist loadscope compatible). The iteration-1 suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py remains the baseline. Both can be run together with `pytest /app/backend/tests/`. Twilio keys intentionally absent — /alerts/send must return 400, alerts/history must contain 'twilio_yok'. Site detail route is /santiyeler/:id (NOT /santiye/:id).
rca of the issue: Minor UI testability issue — /app/frontend/src/components/shared/Bits.jsx line 34: Money component only accepts {value, className, signed}, dropping data-testid passed by callers. In ProgressDetail.jsx:69, `<Money ... data-testid="progress-remaining" />` renders a <span> without the attribute, making the 'Kalan' amount unreachable from Playwright/Cypress by its testid. Fix: spread extra props -> `function Money({value, className, signed=false, ...rest}) { return <span {...rest} className=... />; }`.
